# IPMI Sensor Data Records (SDR) - Fan Sensors
# Output from: ipmitool sdr type "Fan"
# Typical datacenter server example

CPU FAN              | 30 | Fan        | 3200     | RPM    | ok
Chassis FAN 1        | 31 | Fan        | 4100     | RPM    | ok
Chassis FAN 2        | 32 | Fan        | 4050     | RPM    | ok
System FAN           | 33 | Fan        | 3800     | RPM    | ok

# Expected discovery results:
# - 4 FanSensor entries created with sourceType=IpmiSdr
# - Labels: "BMC – CPU FAN", "BMC – Chassis FAN 1", etc.
# - inputPath stores sensor name for re-query

# Expected readIpmiSpeed() result when querying "CPU FAN":
# Command: ipmitool sdr get "CPU FAN"
# Response (see ipmi_sdr_get_fan.txt): Sensor Reading : 3200 RPM
